snippet.title: Cat Tsunami Trailer
snippet.description:
Catabunga Dudes! The surfs up, except this surf is made entirely of cats. That’s right, get ready to surf endlessly on the tops of waves of cats as Kai the cat. Do you think that you’re ready for this? Yes, you are? Purrrrrfect…

Cat Tsunami is currently not released and will be available soon on iOS and Android, in the meantime you can follow Cat Tsunami on…
